It computes KL = 2000 mm and uses P_cr = π²EI/(KL)² without any incorrect statement that K only affects the mode shape. This aligns with the ground truth prompt, which simply states to compute P_cr = π²EI/(KL)² without the erroneous caveat from the incomplete prompt.
